name: Disaster Displacement — Flood-Related New Displacements (annual)
note: New displacements caused specifically by flood events; disaggregated hazard type from IDMC /aggregated/disaster_data/

name: Disaster Displacement — Storm-Related New Displacements (annual)
note: New displacements from storm/cyclone events; extreme weather fragility signal disaggregated by hazard

name: World Justice Project Rule of Law Index (Overall)
note: WJP Rule of Law Index; 0-1 scale (1=strongest); OWID-hosted; covers constraints on government, no corruption, open government, fundamental rights, order & security, regulatory enforcement, civil/criminal justice

name: Conflict IDP Stock (end-year total)
note: Total people living in conflict-induced internal displacement at year-end; headline fragility and crisis duration indicator

name: Conflict New Displacements (annual flow)
note: New internal displacement movements triggered by conflict/violence in the year; a person displaced twice counted twice — flow measure

name: Years in Consecutive Conflict Displacement (derived from IDMC stock series)
note: Count of consecutive years with conflict IDP stock > 0; protracted displacement duration, chronicity indicator

name: Conflict IDP Stock per 1,000 Population (normalized)
note: Conflict IDP stock normalized by population; intensity-adjusted internal displacement burden

name: Press Freedom Index (RSF)
note: Reporters Without Borders Press Freedom Index; 0-100 (100=most free); OWID-hosted; media environment signal

name: WJP Rule of Law — Absence of Corruption
note: Sub-index of WJP RoL measuring corruption absence in executive, judiciary, police, military; 0-1

name: Military Spending (% GDP, SIPRI)
note: Military expenditure as % GDP; SIPRI (CC BY 4.0) via OWID; defence burden and conflict orientation signal

name: Total Displaced Persons to GDP Ratio (derived, IDMC stock / WB GDP)
note: IDP stock relative to economic size; economic displacement burden signal independent of population scale

name: Disaster New Displacements per 1,000 Population (normalized)
note: Disaster displacement flow normalized by population; disaster vulnerability intensity metric

name: Conflict New Displacements per 1,000 Population (normalized)
note: Conflict-induced new displacements normalized by population; cross-country comparability for ML features

name: Total New Displacements (conflict + disaster, annual flow)
note: Combined new displacement movements from all causes; aggregate mobility-shock signal for ML

name: Terrorist Attacks (count, GTD)
note: Annual count of terrorist incidents; GTD via OWID; terrorism frequency and instability signal

name: WJP Rule of Law — Order and Security
note: Sub-index measuring crime control, civil conflict absence, violence against civilians; 0-1

name: Terrorism Deaths (count, GTD)
note: Annual deaths from terrorist attacks; Global Terrorism Database (START/GTD) via OWID; political violence signal
